descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-18 Billing Suggestion · S05 「app 里的 UAT 第 4 步和第 1 步：Generate 时选的模板决定系列，不是徽章或它的预选；通过选择器生成 H&P、Consult note、SNF admission 和 SNF consult；换一个模板 Regenerate」 UAT steps 4 and 1 in the app: the template picked at Generate sets the family, not the badge or its pre-selection; H&P, Consult note, SNF admission and SNF consult generated through the picker; …

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U3 Billing follows the template selected at Generate, not the admission-status badge: with the badge on New Admission and the template overridden to SOAP progress at Generate, the code comes from 99231- …（UAT TC-18；TFA-92596 AC 1；TFA-92599 How it works 4） — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U2 A note can be generated with each of the 8 pilot templates (Hospital: H&P, SOAP progress, Consult note, Discharge summary; …（UAT TC-18；TFA-92599 AC 1；TFA-92599 AC 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr; TFA-92599 in progress
  • U1 The code family is a fixed table keyed on the template, never chosen by the model: H&P and Consult -> 99221-99223 (some commercial payers accept 99252-99255); SOAP progress -> 99231-99233; …（UAT TC-18；TFA-92596 AC 1；TFA-92596 What (template -> family table)） — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U14 Run in both Hospital and Nursing Home and pass in both; Nursing Home has a working billing block with the SNF families.（UAT 3.3；UAT TC-21 step 6；TFA-92599 AC 10） — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr; TFA-92599 in progress

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given Fixture Hospital patient and Nursing Home resident, nothing generated; each leg is its own case with a fresh session (oracleRules 11)

When h-step4: badge New Admission -> H&P pre-selected -> change to SOAP progress -> Generate -> Post-Round -> badge to Consult -> Post-Round -> badge back to New Admission, pick H&P, Regenerate Note. h-hp: badge New Admission, keep H&P, Generate. h-consult: badge Consult, keep Consult note, Generate. …

Then Every pre-selection and override is visible with the picker closed; each code comes from the family of the template picked at that Generate and the stored noteTemplate equals the pick: SOAP progress 99231-99233 (unchanged after the badge change), H&P and Consult note 99221-99223, SNF follow-up 99307-99310, SNF admission and SNF consult 99304-99306; …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs per checkpoint (picker snapshots taken closed, as TC-21 S05; a native select lists every option, so only 'option "X" [selected]' proves a choice): pre-selection, override and badge changes as [selected] options; each billing checkpoint mustContainAny the picked template's family, mustNotContain every other code and the no-result texts (oracleRules 2), billingCard ch …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S05 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-18.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：AGENT · 浏览器 agent — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 dev 跑；来源：dev。
